notes.title: Environment-Enhancement
notes.content:
Hello Farmers!
It's been a while since our last update, and we have some exciting news and updates to share with you.

[b]Concept-Tuesday & Fan-Friday [/b]
We are thrilled to introduce our new weekly events on X (Twitter) and Discord - starting next week! Every Tuesday, join us for Concept-Tuesday where we reveal new ideas and designs. On Fridays, it's all about you with Fan-Friday, showcasing fan art and community creations. We can't wait to see your contributions! You can send your Magical-Harvest related creations in Discord or tag us on X.


[b]Demo [/b]
Our demo is still available over the summer, and we are grateful for all the wonderful feedback we've received. It's been amazing to see how much you all enjoy the game and your curiosity about what's coming next. We had a lot of people playing the demo for over 5 hours!  
What we think was a bit sad, that a lot of players did forget about the runes very quickly and went back to “normal” farm work. The runes with their magic offer a fast way to clear the farm, harvest, water – and using them in the mine. 
Also remember: this was a very early pre-alpha demo! It was meant to see if the system fits, if people like the concept, art style and the main idea - and what can we say? Yes! The feedback was really overwhelming for us! We thank here for all players, streamers and supporters! 

New environment and seasons
[img]https://magicalharvest.github.io/images/blog/2024/2024-07-01_Seasons.png[/img]

[b]Visual Enhancements [/b]
We are currently working on making the game environment even more beautiful. While this means the demo will soon be outdated in terms of visuals, we believe the improvements will be worth the time we put into right now. We're also addressing performance issues to ensure a smoother experience in the future. 
This won’t be implemented in the demo. 

New farm area
[img]https://magicalharvest.github.io/images/blog/2024/2024-07-01_Farm.png[/img]

[b]Farewell to Interns [/b]
We have to say goodbye to two incredible interns, Sassa and Veronika, who have done an outstanding job over the past few months. Thank you both for your hard work – the game wouldn't be where it is without you! 

[img]https://magicalharvest.github.io/images/blog/2024/2024-07-01_SidusConept.png[/img]
Concept: House direction for Sidus-District

[b]Development Progress [/b]
Behind the scenes, we're continuing our search for funding and publishers. It's a challenging time in the game development market, but we're committed to pushing forward.
If you want to help us in any way: feel free to have a look at our Patreon page https://www.patreon.com/moonflamegames

We had a fantastic time at the Nordic Game Conference at the end of May! It was wonderful to see people enjoying the demo and being drawn to our art style.
Also, we are close to 8000 wishlists! So, the first big goal about 7000 is reached! 

[b]Next Steps [/b]
Looking ahead, we are focusing on creating the farm, magical forest, and forest area. After that, we'll be improving some base systems, with a major focus on implementing the AI of the animals – and interactions with them.

Thank you for your continued support and enthusiasm. Stay tuned for more updates, and don't forget to join our  [url=https://discord.gg/8tXMkrMDyy]Discord[/url].

Best wishes, 
Isa

notes.title: Patch Vers. 0.1.67
notes.content:
Another couple of smaller updates to improve the quality of the demo:

[b]Vers.0.1.67[/b]
-    Information in the start screen that Controller support is not the right choice at the moment 
-    Dialogues: you can left click to skip text (before it was just pressing E)
-    Advanced Crafting: you can click on the recipes now to see the needed items (hover shows the name now), even if you can’t craft them yet 
-    Reversed the scroll wheel for the tool bar 
-    Added a second (shorter) path to the mine (in the final game, the maps will be smaller)
-    Improved the fishing cast with mouse click
-    Decoration mode: some chests are now available (when starting a new game & finishing the tutorial) 
-    Bug fixed: you could not put farm ground on a place where you recently destroyed grass, stone or a tree 

Next smaller planned implementations: 
-    The portal from the Farm to the Mine 
-    Mini map for the decoration mode

The current focus is on the Character Customizer-functionality. 

We have a lot more things planned, but the focus is currently on getting more base features done.

notes.title: Patch Vers. 0.1.66
notes.content:
The last unreal engine upgrade caused some problems, that are now hopefully all solved.

And more important: it's not crashing anymore when using the hoe! 

Patch-notes:
[b] Vers. 0.1.66[/b]
- fixed the animation start when using tools - but character is turning instantly now 
- fixed a problem in the mine where the delivered objects were not correctly activated anymore 
- reduced the project size by more than a half (we had an issue with the new UE-Version)

I wish you a lot of fun!
Enjoy your life in Hyldena and test out the first features of Magical Harvest!

notes.title: Demo Patch Vers 0.1.61 -> 0.1.65
notes.content:
In the last few days, a couple of improvements and fixes happened: 

[b]Vers. 0.1.65[/b]
- you can play till day 15 now 
- the sold items are displayed correctly now
- added a "Tutorial-popup" in the mine when at the last quest to get a hint for using runes
- Decoration mode: the orthographic camera is now perspective due to shaking-problems 
- Decoration mode: you can apply the second color to single-colored objects now 
- fixed a bug that prevented spawning dry crops
- fixed a bug that crashed the game when a farm ground got destroyed after a couple of days

[b] Vers. 0.1.64 [/b]
- Engine upgrade 
- Animals are breeding the correct secondary stats now 
- Graphical improvement (got rid of the "blurryness") -> switched from TAA to TSR

[b] Vers. 0.1.63 [/b]
- Some more smaller fps-improvements 
- A debug fps setting in the graphic-settings 
- Random spawn position of trees, grass and stones improved 
- Outlines from Deco-mode are now deactivated correctly when closing the deco mode 
- Maybe the bug in the inventory when dragging an item that creates a "shadow" of this icon is fixed
- Now you can see the names of the items in the Animal-Breeding window

[b]Vers. 0.1.62[/b]
- fixed an issue where an item was not added correctly to the inventory (and overwrote slot 1)
- switched from DirectX12 to DirectX 11 
- improved rendering performance (just a little - but better than nothing)
- you can now see a bit more in the Badlands in the night
- removed the color breeding for the chicken (no colors available yet and chicken is a placeholder anyway!)

[b]Vers. 0.1.61[/b]
- White Powder is now registered correctly when trying to craft Luck-Potions
- Default Fps setting is set to 60 and Vsync off by default

notes.title: Play the demo - NOW!
notes.content:
🎉 Get ready to dive into the magical world of Magical Harvest because the long-awaited demo is finally here and available for you to play!  

🌱 Over the past few days, our team has been hard at work adding a plethora of smaller quality-of-life enhancements to level-up your gaming experience.  

⚠️ Keep in mind, since this is an early release, there might be some performance hiccups along the way. But fear not! Dive into the settings menu and tweak things to your liking if you encounter any bumps in the road.

🎮 We're eager to hear what you think about the game! 
Your thoughts and opinions matter to us, and we can't wait to hear all about your adventures in the world of Magical Harvest. Share your feedback, ideas, and suggestions with us—it's invaluable as we continue to shape the game's development. Send us your screenshots of your farm! 

🌟 Remember, this is just a taste of what's to come. We're not even in the alpha stage yet, but we're thrilled to give you a sneak peek at the core features of Magical Harvest in a fast-paced, speed-mode style!
- Harvesting (and evolving crops)
- Crossbreeding animals
- Using magic
- Exploring (a part of) the mine 
- Sneak peak for the Magical Forest
- Various crafting systems 
- Decoration mode (& its coloring feature)
- Quest-system 
- Fishing 

🔮 And hey, don't forget to join our Discord community! 
It's the perfect place to share your experiences, ask questions, or seek guidance if you find yourself stuck or unsure about your next move. Our friendly community and developers are here to help every step of the way.
[url=https://discord.gg/H8yJCau8e8]Discord[/url]

✨
So what are you waiting for? Let the magic unfold and immerse yourself in the enchanting world of Magical Harvest!
Enjoy the game!  

Best wishes, 
Moon Flame Games

notes.title: Demo Release: 28 April!
notes.content:
Hello together!

Finally a new update! 
We’re still working on improving the demo! The wanted features are there, now we are about to polish what we can. Sadly, we won’t have the last animal model included. But it’s very likely that we can still include it, while the demo is available. 

Oh, right: 
The release of the[b][u] pre-alpha[/u][/b] demo will be: [u][b]Sunday, 28 April. 14:00 PM CET / 08:00 CT [/b][/u]
The demo will be available during the Steam Next-Festival which starts on the 29th. 

Note: keep in mind that this demo is a kind of speed-run through our main system: the evolution part & magic. You can also decorate and explore a part of the mine-system. 
In the final game, the progress won’t be that fast of course! 

[b]What happened since the last update?   [/b]
[i]- New environment style [/i]
Grass got improved. Trees still need a new direction. Farm, Forest, and Badlands got an overhaul. 
[img]https://magicalharvest.github.io/images/blog/2024/MagicalHarvest_Environment.png[/img]

[i]- New Character model for the demo [/i]
In this demo, we won’t have the character customizer yet. But that one will come next! Till then you have to deal with the new demo model only. 
[img]https://magicalharvest.github.io/images/blog/2024/MagicalHarvest_Character_0.png[/img]

[i]- More decorations and props! [/i]
More flowers and especially magic mushrooms! Everyone loves glowing mushrooms, right?!
And you can color them! 
Also, some of our old ugly models got replaced. However, there are still a lot that needs an overhaul.
[img]https://magicalharvest.github.io/images/blog/2024/MagicalHarvest_Decoration.png[/img]
[img]https://magicalharvest.github.io/images/blog/2024/MagicalHarvest_MagicLanterns.png[/img]

[i]- Animals [/i]
We have the cow and the apis included. Chicken comes next! Still, without animations and only on a little cutscene. 
[img]https://magicalharvest.github.io/images/blog/2024/MagicalHarvest_Cows.png[/img]

What’s next? 
Improving, improving, improving!
We are doing as much and as good as we can in that time. 
We are not guaranteeing a good performance, if you have an older computer since we are not focusing on this part yet. Maybe it’s not a trouble at all – just be warned. 
There won’t be controller support for this demo yet either. 

We are really looking forward and wish you a good time! 

So, back to work here! 
Best wishes, 
Moon Flame Games

notes.title: Women's Day Sale & Demo-plans
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
Welcome to the 2nd update in 2024! 

At the end of February, Martina joined our team as a 2D & 3D Artist. She is bringing old, less attractive assets to new brilliance! We are welcoming her in the team!

[b]Women's Day Sale[/b]
Currently, the Women’s Day Sale event is happening on Steam, and we are participating. Support games created by women! Unfortunately, women in the gaming industry face more challenges than men, such as difficulties in obtaining financing. This trend extends to many startup sectors, interestingly, as startups led by women tend to be more successful on average than those led by men. Just a side note...

[img]https://magicalharvest.github.io/images/blog/2024/Screenshot 2024-03-02 063117.png[/img]

[b]Farm Fest & Demo[/b]
The next major Steam festival we're participating in is the Farm-Fest at the end of April. We will be 
presenting our first demo in Unreal Engine 5. Since November, we've been transferring content from the Unity engine to Unreal Engine 5. It takes time, but we are on track, and we've already assembled a small tutorial. This tutorial won't be the final one in the game but serves as a "Speed-run Tutorial",  introducing you to various aspects of farm life in Magical Harvest.

Not all base features will be in the demo, and the visual aspect won't be final. Nevertheless, you can:
•	Get acquainted with our decoration system
•	Enjoy the satisfying feeling of using magic
•	Experience the basics of cross breeding magical creatures
•	Discover the first magical farm plants
•	Apply various crafting possibilities
•	Get a first glimpse of the magical forest, initially a barren landscape 
And a few more small things... As of now, the demo will only be available in English.

[img]https://magicalharvest.github.io/images/blog/2024/Screenshot 2024-03-02 134242.png[/img]
[img]https://magicalharvest.github.io/images/blog/2024/Screenshot 2024-03-02 134301.png[/img]

[b]New features & assets![/b]
That's about the demo. What happened in February?
•	Quest System: Implemented and works in combination with the basic dialogue system
•	Weather in Hyldena: It can now be cloudy and rainy
•	Mine Sections: A part of the mine can now be explored, providing insight into our mine progression system
•	Random Objects can be found in the world
•	It's not so quiet anymore: Initial dummy sound effects are present
•	Assets: Some new assets for the decoration menu

[img]https://magicalharvest.github.io/images/blog/2024/Screenshot 2024-03-02 143400.png[/img]

[b]March plans[/b]
What's planned for March? 
March primarily focuses on animal breeding. It's not certain if you can take care of animals in the demo, but we're working hard to make it possible. Since crossbreeding is a key feature in Magical Harvest, the focus is on providing insight into "Crossbreeding." 
We had a prototype minigame for this, but we're replacing it with a theme-appropriate one that better illustrates the magical crossing of animals.

Another goal is to include at least a showcase section for our "The Sims"-inspired dialogue system for the bachelors. This depends on the progress of the animals and the rest of the Demo progress. March is still about adding more content; April will focus on improving the current version.

[img]https://magicalharvest.github.io/images/blog/2024/Screenshot 2024-03-02 133812.png[/img]

In addition to feature content, the focus is on new 3D models. Crafting tables and farm tools will be revamped. Also, we need to slowly define the style direction for our main character model.

As you can see, there's a lot to do! Our motivation is stronger than ever, and we are thrilled about Farm-Fest in April to showcase the demo!

Best regards, 
Your Magical Harvest Team 
[i]Moon Flame Games[/i]

notes.title: Year in review
notes.content:
How quickly this year has come to an end! There have been so many changes this year that it just flew by.     
      
    First of all, we would like to thank you all for your support over the years! Every comment, every wish list entry, every sign of life, no matter how small, is a great motivation factor for us!     
    Continue to be patient and stick with us!     
          
         [img]https://magicalharvest.github.io/images/blog/2023/Forest.jpg[/img]   
    [b] Life in the forest as indie developers[/b]     
      We moved to the centre of Sweden and now live in a small village in the middle of the forest, an hour away from the nearest small town, and got married.     
          
    [img]https://magicalharvest.github.io/images/blog/2023/Forest_2.jpg[/img]   
    You often find game studios in the centre of big cities. However, we are not fans of such cities and like nature and also the possibility of being able to work from home at any time.     
     For us, the location in the middle of the forest is perfect. We see a lot of wildlife (birds, deer, foxes, rabbits), we have snow in winter and it's quiet. At night you can hardly see the stars more clearly as the light pollution is not very strong. This leads to a good work-life balance. We also have the chance to see the Northern Lights here.     
            [img]https://magicalharvest.github.io/images/blog/2023/2023-12-27 Does.jpg[/img]   
     And we also support life outside the cities. Young people in particular are being drawn more and more to the cities, which is a pity.     
        
    [b] Magical Harvest[/b]        
      It's hard to believe, but we've been working on the game for 2 years now. Starting in Unity, we have now switched to Unreal Engine 5. Our Unity game version is now officially a prototype.        
         
             [img]https://magicalharvest.github.io/images/blog/2023/2023-12-26 2 year Comp.png[/img]     
     But from the beginning:        
     The year started with a focus on adding animals to our Unity prototype. The first daily routines of the NPCs were also implemented and with them the first part of the city.        
         
    The character creation feature and the creation of new character models took up a lot of time. This took almost the entire months of March and April. This was followed by a lot of visual revisions:        
     The farm trees, the grass, more items in decoration mode and the ability to colour decoration items.        
             
     This was followed in August by the seasons in the game and the models & icons of all farm plants (except flowers and trees).          
     The dialogue system was expanded and adapted to the mood of the NPCs and made more dynamic.        
                        [img]https://magicalharvest.github.io/images/blog/2023/2023-10-25_SGC_2.jpg[/img]     
     But then came the radical change. In September, the game engine Unity introduced a new payment model and destroyed the trust of many users. We took this opportunity to try out Unreal Engine 5 and immediately fell in love with it. From October onwards, the game has been developed in UE5. This has the advantage that previous elements in the game can also be improved - in addition to the graphical jump forwards.        
             
       At the same time, we started to be part of the "Sweden Game Arena Coaching Programme"! Since then, we have been receiving support there, which is centred around setting up a company and putting together a team, in addition to information on how to get financial support.        
              
              [img]https://magicalharvest.github.io/images/blog/2023/Screenshot 2023-11-20 152802.png[/img]   
      Through the programme, we were able to take part at the "Sweden Games Conference" in October, where we were also a nominee for the best "Indicator".        
     After the successful conference, things were a little more quiet from our side. The reason for this was that we focussed fully on the implementation of game features in UE5. In addition, the company "Moon Flame Games" was officially founded, which is now our game studio. Additionally, we had interviews with interns and are happy to announce that our team will grow by two artists in January and two in March.        
     We are really looking forward to it!        
     The whole process will take Magical Harvest to the next level! Especially visually.        
             
     Over the year, some of the Bachelors have been illustrated and we still love our artist Lura for this wonderful work!        
               [img]https://magicalharvest.github.io/images/blog/2023/Screenshot 2023-12-27 032218.png[/img]   
     [b] Outlook for 2024[/b]        
        Production has now started and we hope to implement all the basic features in 2024 and, of course, to be able to start with the story content beyond that.        
       The progress of the game depends heavily on when we receive funding. The more we get, the bigger the team can become.                  
       Of course, you don't get financial support just like that. A lot of preparatory work has to be done and that takes time.        
      However, we are very confident and are working hard to achieve this goal!        
               
  We are also planning a playable demo for April/May and are already very excited! We don't want to reveal anything about the scope at the moment.        
        
 The game will definitely be playable at the Nordic Game Conference in May.        
  We're also planning to be at the Sweden Games Conference again in October and maybe even at Gamescom in Cologne - but that hasn't been decided yet.        
           
 [b] End of the year[/b]        
    The year has now come to an end and we are heading into the new year with a positive feeling!        
   We wish you all the best from the bottom of our hearts and thank you again for your support!        
  Special thanks also go to our Patreons on  [url=https://www.patreon.com/moonflamegames][u]https://www.patreon.com/moonflamegames[/u] [/url]!        
        [img]https://magicalharvest.github.io/images/blog/2023/2023-12-26 Bachelors.png[/img]   
            
     With warmest regards,        
      Isa & Marie Hellström        
     [i]  Moon Flame Games[/i]

notes.title: Another milestone and bachelor Azriel
notes.content:
We are excited to share some significant milestones that have recently occurred at Moon Flame Games AB, marking the beginning of an incredible chapter in our journey!        
        
[b] Moon Flame Games AB is officially founded! [/b]        
With great joy and pride, we announce the official establishment of Moon Flame Games AB. Now, the real search for investors and publishers can begin!        
        [img]https://magicalharvest.github.io/images/blog/2023/Screenshot 2023-10-22 082604.png[/img]  
  
  [b] Great Internship Interviews[/b]        
  We've had promising internship discussions with talented artists eager to strengthen our team. The creativity and passion we've witnessed promise a positive future for Moon Flame Games.        
         
 [b] Bachelor Azriel[/b]        
  Azriel is finished! One of our most popular Bachelors has now his illustrations! And we love the result! What do you think about him?        
  You can find more information here:  [url=https://magicalharvest.github.io/cast_bachelors.html][u] Magical Harvest - Bachelors[/u] [/url]!         
         [img]https://magicalharvest.github.io/images/blog/2023/Azriel.png[/img]   
        
  [b]Unreal Engine 5 Updates[/b]        
 Visually, not much has changed in the last month, but many game elements have been added. Progress in Unreal Engine 5 is faster than expected, and the learning curve is steep. So, we're looking forward very positively to the future!   
        
  [*]Item Creator         
  A utility tool to input all item data into the game, all with just one button click. Currently, there are 634 items (excluding decorations). Quite a lot has accumulated there.
   [img]https://magicalharvest.github.io/images/blog/2023/Screenshot 2023-11-30 190312.png[/img] 
   [img]https://magicalharvest.github.io/images/blog/2023/Screenshot 2023-11-30 190351.png[/img]       [/*]    
  [*] Farm Plants Creator         
 Another utility tool to prepare all farm plants based on 3D models for gameplay. This includes creating an object in Unreal Engine and a system for growth phases. Within a few minutes, we had all the spring plants back in the game. 
   [img]https://magicalharvest.github.io/images/blog/2023/Screenshot 2023-11-30 190506.png[/img]      [/*]       
 [*]  Using Items         
 The logic for using items has been implemented, requiring some background work.      [/*]      
[*]    Sensor         
 Tools or magic are used through the "Sensor." The sensor displays the corresponding positions on the ground that are influenced by a tool or magic. In fact, the sensor now works even better than in Unity.      
   [img]https://magicalharvest.github.io/images/blog/2023/Screenshot 2023-12-01 014811.png[/img] 
[/*]        
[*]  Farm Plants         
 The logic for farm plants is implemented. They grow, can be watered, and eventually harvested.      [/*]        
[*]  Trees, Grass, and Stones         
 These can now be completely removed with tools.      [/*]        
[*]  Items & Inventory         
 Items can now be obtained in the game world. The inventory has also been implemented, currently only mouse-operable. Controller support is pending. A chest for storing items has also been reintegrated.        
         [img]https://magicalharvest.github.io/images/blog/2023/Screenshot 2023-11-30 190621.png[/img] 
 [*]  Other         
 Various minor things have been added, such as notifications when an item is obtained or a system for secondary information.                
         
 [b]Outlook[/b]        
  In December, we will decide on personnel changes (adding interns).        
 Implementations in the game:        
  [*]   Storage system[/*]      [*]   Animations and visual effects[/*]          [*]   Crafting[/*]        
  We wish everyone a joyful Christmas/winter season and hope to welcome you healthy and cheerful again in the next year!        
       
 Liebe Grüße,       
 Isa & Marie       
 Moon Flame Games

notes.title: A lot of positive feedback!
notes.content:
[b]Sweden Game Arena[/b]

We were at our first live event in Sweden – the Sweden Game Conference (25 & 26th October). It was an event for developers to share experiences, network and get feedback. There we had the incredible opportunity to show Magical Harvest, pitch the game in front of publishers and receive feedback!           
And the feedback was overwhelming!           
On top of that - we were also a nominee for the indicator of the year! 

  [img]https://magicalharvest.github.io/images/blog/2023/2023-10-25_SGC_0.jpg[/img]    
  [img]https://magicalharvest.github.io/images/blog/2023/2023-10-25_SGC_1.jpg[/img]        

[b]Some facts and reviews from the event [/b][*] The most created species was the Drakys-Species (no one played a human or an elf) [/*][*] Valariel is more popular than Azriel (which surprised us)  [/*][*] Magical Harvest was mostly compared to Stardew Valley, but MH feels more rewarding - especially in terms of farming (*happy *) [/*][*] Using magic is very, very satisfying  [/*][*] The Unreal Engine 5 looks awesome and the switch from Unity to UE5 was worth it [/*][*] The cross breeding is a very hooking feature  [/*][*] The Nomlings melt hearts! * Nom nom nom * We’ve been asked for plushies of them and more merchandise    [/*]
  [img]https://magicalharvest.github.io/images/blog/2023/2023-10-25_SGC_2.jpg[/img]       
Many people were interested, we made new contacts and are ready to continue to the next phase of development. 

[b]Unreal Engine 5[/b]
And based on this follows a deeper insight into the UE5-porting. 
Since we’ve been asked a lot about a demo, I’ll be focusing on that, while I re-implement the features. 
In the last 4 weeks I couldn’t do much programming, because the focus was on the Sweden Game Conference which meant creating a pitch, preparing flyers, roll-ups etc for the event and getting as many visuals in UE5 done as possible to have a small showcase version. 
First, I had to learn the basics of UE, because Unity and UE are of course not the same and I had to learn the “Unreal way” first. 

 [img]https://magicalharvest.github.io/images/blog/2023/Screenshot 2023-10-18 UnrealUnityComparison.png[/img]       

Already implemented:[*] The seasonal system with changing terrain and textures [/*]  [*] Day-night cycle  [/*]    [*] The farm grid [/*]      [*] The basis for creating a farm ground, planting & harvesting crops  [/*]        [*] The basis for removing grass, stones, and trees on the farm [/*]          [*] A system for switching between maps  [/*]            [*] Basic UI-parts [/*]              [*] First part of inventory system [/*]                [*] Basic walk animation [/*]                

So not much yet (because it’s mostly the basis and not fully implemented), but over the next weeks I’ll be focusing fully on UE5. The next steps include the most important basic parts: [*] Implementing the Item-creator to get the hundreds of items back into the game [/*]  [*] Creating the “sensor” that is responsible for the multi-selection[/*]    [*] Inventory drag and drop system[/*]

 [img]https://magicalharvest.github.io/images/blog/2023/Screenshot 2023-10-16 031023.png[/img]       

The list of features that need to be implemented is very long, but I have to start at one point. I can’t wait to see more progress again! 
The switch to UE5 is also a chance, to improve everything and make the game even more user friendly.         
         
 Best regards,          
 Isa

notes.title: Switch to Unreal Engine 5
notes.content:
This time there is not so much new to report.           
   As mentioned last time, I tried out the Unreal Engine 5 (UE5) (due to the Unity disaster 2 weeks ago). And what can I say? I'm going to stick with UE5. There are a few reasons for that, and they don't just have to do with Unity.           
            
   In short: for my personal future and especially for Magical Harvest I see much more advantages in UE5 than in Unity.           
   The biggest advantages lie in the graphical aspect. The game looks a lot better with much less effort than in Unity. It's also a very good opportunity to make the code base more stable.           
           
  Porting will take a few months. In the time I'll provide you with updates and pictures as best I can!           
           
  [img]https://magicalharvest.github.io/images/blog/2023/Screenshot 2023-09-16 120910.png[/img]       
  [img]https://magicalharvest.github.io/images/blog/2023/Screenshot 2023-09-24 143422.png[/img]       

  At the end of October we will be at the "Sweden Game Conference". There you can play Magical Harvest ( the last Unity version) and get the first glimpses of the Unreal Engine 5 version.     
                 
  [img]https://magicalharvest.github.io/images/blog/2023/Screenshot 2023-09-27 145940.png[/img]    
  
  At the same time we will pitch there for the first time in front of publishers. Let's see what the results will be. Of course the event has to be prepared from our side and that takes time :(.           
          
   Oh and I have the new trailer ready (except for voiceover), which at the same time is already outdated again because of the switch to UE... Hurray or something.          
          
[previewyoutube=zZp3__7Dr2w;full][/previewyoutube]      
     
 Since there is nothing else to report, here are a few pictures in UE5. Next time I'll write a bit more about the UE5 implementation.                   
         
 Best regards,          
 Isa

notes.title: Unity!!!
notes.content:
What a week! Unity (the game engine I use for Magical Harvest) has introduced a new payment model, which has caused quite a bit of unrest among users of the engine. A large number of indie developers use this engine.          
                 
 [b]   What's the issue? [/b]          
  Unity's initial post with the new features stated a payment model where developers have to pay a fee to Unity for every install of their games over a certain amount and install count. So if you install and uninstall the game 100x, 100x that fee ($0.20 per install) is charged from the developer (they have since backed down from that and say each install on a new device costs). Now consider how many pirated games there are that don't even make money for an install.          
  [img]https://magicalharvest.github.io/images/blog/2023/unity.png[/img]       
    
   I'm not too worried about the fees themselves with Magical Harvest. The threshold is set really high (with a monthly subscription account, that's $1m in revenue AND 1m installs). But the trust in Unity is gone and people don't want to continue supporting this company. Many negative things (technical things, promises) have been overlooked so far, but this has now taken the cake.  Whether this would be allowed in Europe is another matter altogether...?            
           
  [b]How does this effect Magical Harvest?[/b]          
    I have to elaborate a bit more on this. Currently I am in a coaching program to establish a game company, to prepare myself for pitching to publishers and to find a publisher to pay team members I would like to have for support.           
    This of course leaves me with a decision to stay with Unity, since I'm already very far along with it and can present presentable gameplay - or to take longer and switch to Unreal Engine 5. Switching would mean it would set me back a few months. You don't just switch engines and be 100% efficient with it like before. It's a new learning process. Of course, it's easier to switch than to start from 0.          
                    
[b] So Unity or Unreal Engine 5 (UE5)? [/b]          
  Many game companies (even smaller ones like me) are just switching to a different engine with their Unity projects, some of which are already 2 years old. I'm still undecided (because of the publisher thing), but have started looking into UE5. I want to give it some time to see if it's really worth it for me personally or not. My personal future also depends on it, because UE5 offers quite some advantages - also on the job market.            
          
  So it remains exciting in this area and I will keep you informed about my decisions.           
          
 [b] But what has happened in the last 2 weeks?[/b]               
  I could not do everything planned, because somehow a lot of smaller things came in between or demanded more time:          
          
  - [b] Flowers: [/b] 23/40 flowers are finished in their first phase. Their color variants and icons are still missing.           
  Because of the color variants and the number of flowers I changed the whole system of how color variants are handled in the game. This took the longest time. But now color variants can be inserted for several Items without any problems. Also for e.g. crops (if there is a need - keyword: golden apple or something like that).           
            
  - [b]New rocks:[/b] there are new rocks! They are now used consistently everywhere in the game!           
 - [b]New mine: [/b]because of the new rocks the mine has got a new shape, too.          
  [img]https://magicalharvest.github.io/images/blog/2023/Screenshot 2023-09-15 171039.png[/img]     
            
 - [b]Sequence[/b] from developing field plants to the next magic level           
      [img]https://magicalharvest.github.io/images/blog/2023/Screenshot 2023-09-10 065731.png[/img]             
  - A [b]trailer sequence[/b] for the change of the wasteland to the magic forest for the trailer        
[previewyoutube=_9lHMPc0PpE;full][/previewyoutube]  
   
          
  [b]Planned for the next two weeks: [/b]          
   - Working on a trailer          
  - Working on a "showcase" demo for the "Sweden Game Conference           
  - Working on a pitch for the "Sweden Game Conference          
   - Flowers: adding color variations for spring and summer.           
           
  And I'll keep looking at the Unreal Engine on the side. Let's see if it convinces me.
